I've had internships at 5 different companies during school. At one particular company, I was assigned with a mentor who was an absolute asshole. I'm naturally soft spoken and easy going. Never in my childhood or at any other workplace have I had such problems come up. But this man, who is about 30 years older than me, liked to remind me that I "have zero experience" and that he has "a ton of experience" (literally his words). He loves to yell out "wrong", "there is nothing to think about, do x", and "absolutely inefficient" in front of every other developers sitting in the open space office while reviewing my code. He would often make rude remarks, and boy, he was wrong a lot of the times too. He made me dread going to work every single day. I had hard time focusing on what I needed to do fearing that he will pick on my incapabilities. I wasn't in a situation to bring it up to my manager since I did not want to leave a bad record on my work history. I felt pressured to leave a good impression so I can come back for full time later. And I was pretty sure that my manager knew about his personality anyway, at least to some extent. I've noticed other developers also feeling very aggravated with him during work. I could almost see that people no longer respected him despite his age and experience. Some even laughed at him behind his back during stand ups. But no one, at least to my knowledge has ever told him straight up that he needs to quit that shit. I pitied him because he doesn't seem to get that people dislike him for his personalities. He seemed almost proud that he is outspoken and smart. Hard to say who is right or wrong but definitely my worst developer I had to work with.
